title: A Wyoming shed was a 140-year-old Chinese laundry; it will become a museum exhibit after restoration
summary_full: A weathered Wyoming cabin used as a storage shed for decades turned out to be a 140-year-old Chinese laundry and bathhouse owned by Sam Sing. After an eight-year effort, the historic building has been moved to a museum, where it will be restored and used to tell the story of Lander’s early Chinese community.
